QF.id: AIFM CIII Modern Portfolio Theory and Capital Market Theory_3

question.text: Satpura Market-Neutral Fund's analyst Mr. Rohan Kulkarni projects the following one-year scenario returns on stock 'TCL': Boom (probability 0.30) 18%; Normal (0.50) 10%; Recession (0.20) -4%. What is the ex-ante expected return on TCL?

explanation.text: The Logic: E(R) = Sum(P_i * R_i) = 0.30*18% + 0.50*10% + 0.20*(-4%) = 5.4% + 5.0% + (-0.8%) = 9.6%. This follows the ex-ante probability-weighted return formula given in the workbook. The Trap: (A) 9.4% mishandles one of the leg contributions. (C) 8.0% takes a simple average without probabilities. (D) 12.0% wrongly uses only the two positive scenarios. Note: Workbook pages 51-52 give the ex-ante return formula and a worked probability-weighted example. Compute Sum(P_i * R_i) precisely without rounding any leg.
